en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a fetter, an unwholesome state that is a fetter arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a tie, an unwholesome state that is a tie arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome but not an *ogha*, an unwholesome *ogha* state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a hindrance, a state that is unwholesome and a hindrance arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a hindrance, a state that is unwholesome and a hindrance arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with grasping, an unwholesome state associated with grasping arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
